recentItems.title: US says shot down 2 drones over Bahrain, denies radar strike
recentItems.description:
US says shot down 2 drones over Bahrain, denies radar strike

US Central Command (CENTCOM) says two Iranian drones launched towards Bahrain shot down, with no injuries or damage. CENTCOM also denied IRGC claims that it had attacked a US “early-warning radar” in Bahrain earlier in the day.

recentItems.title: Iran targets US Asset in Bahrain: Revolutionary guard says it destroyed radar system
recentItems.description:
Iran says it has destroyed a US early-warning radar system in Bahrain in retaliation for a strike on a telecommunications facility near the Strait of Hormuz, warning of further escalation if US attacks continue and ships transit without its approval.

Al Jazeera’s Resul Serdar reports.

recentItems.title: Canary Islands migration: Spain says surge in migrants straining services
recentItems.description:

Al Jazeera’s Bernard Smith reports.
